title: Search-Eval Captures
description: What the shopper-facing engine returned per term. Wraps the bare row array the per-store builders used, because a capture with no provenance cannot be re-verified: the verify stage needs to know which path produced a finding in order to re-check it through a different one.

captured_via.description: The concrete path used. The verify stage MUST use a different one (L08).

chunks.description: L11. Capture proceeds in paced chunks so grading can be pipelined against it and so cumulative rate limits are respected.

no_results_msg.description: The engine's own empty-state text. Distinguishes 'none today' from 'failed to load' - without it the two look identical.

items.description: Organic result titles, in rank order. Carousel and sponsored tiles must be excluded, not merely deprioritized (L09).

organic_grid_found.description: L09. When the organic grid does not render, this is FALSE and items must be empty. Never fall back to carousel tiles.

recall.description: Present only for terms whose query-pack entry has_key=true. Emitted here rather than in the board so the raw measurement survives independently of presentation.

extra_skus.description: L03-adjacent. Results outside the key that genuinely match are FACET BACKFILL candidates - search telling the catalog what it is missing - not automatically precision errors.

synonym_candidates.description: Mined from the vocabulary of key members search MISSED, diffed against those it found. Each arrives with the SKU that proves it and its direction fixed by which side the node name sits on.
